messages.english: Review seed allocations and planned pack counts.
messages.translation: Hlahloba dabelo tsa dipeo le dipalo tsa diphuthelo tse rerilweng.
Hlahloba phumantsho ya dipeo e rerilweng

messages.english: Crop planner → Nursery requirements → Seed sourcing
messages.translation: Moradi wa dijalo → Ditlhoko tsa bodirelo ba ho hodisa dimela → Phumantsho ya dipeo

messages.english: Open the nursery review for saved planned batches, add the batches that can share a seed supply, and enter your allocation and seeds per pack. Review the planned requirements before downloading the CSV. Blank counts stay unknown; these inputs do not record seed stock, place an order or cover all farm seed demand.
messages.translation: Bula tlhahlobo ya bodirelo ba ho hodisa dimela bakeng sa dihlopha tse rerilweng tse bolokilweng, eketsa dihlopha tse ka arolelanang kabelo ya dipeo, mme o kenye kabelo ya hao le dipeo ka phuthelo ka nngwe. Hlahloba ditlhoko tse rerilweng pele o jarolla CSV. Dipalo tse se nang letho di dula di sa tsejwe; dintlha tsena tse kentsweng ha di rekote setoko sa dipeo, ha di etse odara kapa ho akaretsa tlhoko yohle ya dipeo tsa polasi.
